rationale: Reallocate scarce fp16 export budget toward the recurrent tail attention value path. The current best family already leans on reverse-tail recurrence and quant-aware endgame; this edit keeps q/k/v float for recurrent tail blocks, keeps attention projection float for the last two blocks, and trims second-to-last MLP projection float retention to save bytes for the path most likely to survive the exact int8+zlib roundtrip.
title: Tail Value-Path FP16 Swap
